title: Wealth Taxation, Including Net Wealth, Capital and Exit Taxes (Volume 2: case studies)
by: WIFO with CASE, PwC EU Services, IEB, ifo and VATT, for the European Commission (DG TAXUD)
summary: Commission-commissioned study of net wealth, capital and exit taxes; Dialogos reports it puts the yield of a European net wealth tax on ultra-high-net-worth people at 1.2 billion euro a year for Cyprus at 2%. Abstract only read.
